headlines.description: — Norman Powell scored 23 points, Matas Buzelis added 18 points and nine rebounds, and the short-handed Chicago Bulls won for the second night in a row with a 117-106 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bulls overcome travel delay and injuries to beat the Timberwolves 117-106

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — The small-ball Milwaukee Brewers playing in the smallest market in the majors are World Series champions for the first time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers beat the Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to win the first World Series title in franchise history
